senses.gloss:
वियम

VIYAMA . One of the three sons of the hermit śataśṛṅga. He killed sudeva, the commander of the army of ambarīṣa and he also was killed in a battle. (M.B. śānti Parva, Dākṣiṇātya Pāṭha, Chapter 98).

वियति

VIYATI . A son of nahuṣa. (bhāgavata, skandha 9; viṣṇu purāṇa, Chapter 4).
